name: Stalwart (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite: Magus hexcrafter archetype

Benefit: A hexcrafter magus can use mental and physical resiliency to avoid certain attacks. If she makes a Fortitude or Will saving throw against an attack that has a reduced effect on a successful save, she instead avoids the effect entirely. This ability can only be used if the hexcrafter magus is wearing light armor, medium armor, or no armor. A helpless hexcrafter magus does not gain the benefit of the stalwart ability.
